To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed an efficient algorithm for biclustering of gene expression data, capable of solving general biclustering of thousands of genes and hundreds of conditions within minutes, and that we have demonstrated that our algorithm outperforms the state-of-the-art in biclustering.

we have developed a novel algorithm for solving a general biclustering of gene expression data, capable of solving large-scale problems efficiently, and have demonstrated the improved performance of the algorithm on various benchmark data and real gene expression data.

we have developed a QUBIC algorithm to reliably identify all statistically significant (sub)groups of genes with (all) similar expression patterns under subsets of experimental conditions, and that the QUBIC can do so very efficiently.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing an effective and efficient algorithm to solve the general bicluster problem, a challenging task for which no effective and efficient algorithms have been reported.
the development and evaluation of a novel biclustering algorithm, which can identify all significant biclusters, including those with scaling patterns, from large-scale gene expression data.
the development of a new algorithm for biclustering analyses of gene expression profiles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the QUBIC is a highly effective and efficient biclustering algorithm that can solve general biclustering in a very robust and reliable manner.
the QUBIC method provides an efficient and reliable tool for biclustering analyses of gene expression profiles.
QUBIC is a powerful and efficient algorithm capable of solving general biclustering in a more effective manner than any existing algorithms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel biclustering algorithm that can solve the general bicluster problem efficiently, reliably, and accurately.
the QUBIC is a reliable, efficient, and general-purpose biclustering algorithm that should be a useful tool for analyses of gene-expression data and other related biological problems.

we have developed a new biclustering algorithm that can solve the general bicluster problems efficiently, capable of handling tens of thousands of gene expression data under thousands of experimental conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the QUBIC biclustering algorithm is a powerful tool for the analyses of gene expression and related data.
QUBIC provides an effective and efficient tool for analyzing gene expression data in the form of biclusters, a powerful way to identify functional modules of genes under specific conditions.

the QUBIC is an efficient and effective tool for identifying statistically significant biclustering patterns in large-scale gene expression data sets, and it will facilitate further applications of biclustering to various biological problems.
